scope: Industrial and non-financial business diagnostics: accounts, SBS industry, capital, production, capacity surveys, energy, business demography, ownership, trade characteristics, FIGARO and PRODCOM. All returned geographies/dimensions; 2010 onwards. Not the entire Eurostat database.
